expectations.text: States plainly that the not-empty check is insufficient
expectations.evidence: "A non-empty-table test would likely have passed during this incident: rows still existed"

expectations.text: Identifies the COALESCE to zero as the mechanism that made the failure silent
expectations.evidence: "COALESCE(..., 0)` turned missing join results into plausible revenue values"

expectations.text: Recommends reconciliation against a source of truth, not only shape checks
expectations.evidence: "A reconciliation: compare dashboard revenue to an independent source-of-truth aggregate for the same period"

expectations.text: Recommends that assertions run before publication rather than after, so bad data cannot reach the dashboard
expectations.evidence: "blocking checks on the staging model before dashboard publication" and "Build → validate staging → promote only on pass"

expectations.text: Recommends a data contract or schema check so an upstream rename fails loudly and attributably
expectations.evidence: "A source data contract: required upstream column, type, and version must be present. A rename fails ingestion instead of becoming nulls."

expectations.text: Recommends volume or null-rate assertions rather than only a non-empty check
expectations.evidence: "A join-integrity assertion before any COALESCE" and "Volume/cardinality guards: historical weekday-aware row and revenue floors/ceilings"

expectations.text: Treats three weeks of nobody noticing as a detection gap worth its own fix
expectations.evidence: No mention of the three-week detection gap or monitoring/alerting as a separate concern

expectations.text: Explains why a silently wrong number is more dangerous than a failed pipeline
expectations.evidence: Describes the hazard but does not explain the relative danger of silent wrongness vs. explicit failure
